verdict.rationale: Kushki publishes its own step-by-step integration guides for a working card flow: accept a card payment, authorization and capture, and refunds. It also documents test data and moving to production, and offers a kushki.js library, a customizable payment form and e-commerce plugins, so a docs-driven integration path exists. The pack does not show the copy-paste code samples themselves, which languages or SDKs they cover, or any evidence on time-to-integrate. The probe notes the old /cl/en docs tree now returns 404 after the move, but that is a site migration, not a failure of the integration guides. Missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste code samples in multiple programming languages or SDKs, an OpenAPI spec (the probe 404'd), and hands-on or independent corroboration of a same-day integration.
